entities.summary: Pellegrino Ernetti was an Italian Catholic Benedictine priest, musicologist and physicist. He later attracted international attention for claims regarding a device he called the Chronovisor, which he alleged was capable of observing past events. These claims, however, have been widely regarded as unsubstantiated.
